I replied in the thread under your message in #coastal-team.

The official handoff was November 3, 2025. Moss's November 2 digest says the account "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03," and your December 8 cutover recap gives the same date. Kwame fully took over day to day on November 22, 2025, after you kept running the account through November 21. For the tracker, I'd use November 3 as the official date and note November 22 as the day-to-day takeover.
